datasets.title: Annual probability of extreme heat and drought events, derived from Lange et al 2020
datasets.description: Annual probability maps of extreme heat and drought events on a 0.5° grid, derived from Lange et al. (2020) by converting event time series into yearly occurrence probabilities for historical baseline and future periods (2030, 2050, 2080) under RCP2.6 and RCP6.0.
datasets.purpose: To provide a simple, comparable probability layer (and associated population exposure) that supports screening, planning, and risk analytics for climate resilience across regions and time horizons using a consistent ISIMIP2b modeling framework.
datasets.details: This draft dataset was generated by the University of Oxford using the open pipeline at https://github.com/nismod/isimip-exposure to transform the Lange et al. (2020, Earth's Future, doi:10.1029/2020EF001616) event time series into annual probabilities. Drought events are defined as soil-moisture below 2.5th percentile for >=7 consecutive months, while extreme heat events are defined as concurrent exceedance of relative temperature and absolute temperature-humidity thresholds. The dataset covers 8 hydrological models forced by 4 GCMs (baseline, RCP2.6, RCP6.0) for time periods 2020, 2030, 2050, and 2080 at 0.5° resolution. Population exposure is computed assuming any population within the event footprint is exposed and is held constant at 2020 levels using JRC GHSL GHS-POP R2023A. ISIMIP2b inputs and outputs are available via ESGF. The dataset is shared under CC0 1.0 and should be cited with Lange et al. (2020) and appropriately acknowledge ISIMIP data providers.

entity.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)

sources.name: ISIMIP2b Impact Model Output Data
sources.description: Global hydrological model simulations of soil moisture and other climate impact variables, based on 8 hydrological models forced by 4 GCMs (IPSL-CM5A-LR, HadGEM2-ES, MIROC5, GFDL-ESM2M) under baseline, RCP2.6 and RCP6.0 emission scenarios at 0.5° spatial resolution. Used to identify drought events when monthly soil moisture falls below the 2.5th percentile of preindustrial baseline for at least 7 consecutive months. Lineage: Inter-Sectoral Impact Model Intercomparison Project Phase 2b (ISIMIP2b) - See Frieler et al. (2017) and Lange et al. (2020) for full methodology

sources.name: GHS-POP Global Population Grid R2023A
sources.description: Global population grid at 250m resolution for the year 2020, developed by the Joint Research Centre (JRC). Used to calculate population exposure by overlaying population distribution with hazard footprints. Population is held constant at 2020 levels across all time periods. Lineage: Schiavina M., Freire S., Carioli A., MacManus K. (2023) GHS-POP R2023A - GHS population grid multitemporal (1975-2030). Methodology described in Freire S., MacManus K., Pesaresi M., Doxsey-Whitfield E., Mills J. (2016)

sources.name: ISIMIP Exposure Processing Pipeline
sources.description: Processing model that converts ISIMIP2b time series data into annual probability of occurrence for extreme heat and drought events. Calculates population exposure by multiplying gridded population by hazard footprints, aggregating to annual probabilities for current (2020) and future periods (2030, 2050, 2080). Lineage: Developed by University of Oxford researchers, based on methodology from Lange et al. (2020). Processing code version: fcfbeff6778f697a5a470ac20dd912fd426a7f98

lineage.description: Annual probability grids for extreme heat and drought events derived from bias-corrected ISIMIP2b climate impact model outputs. Daily maximum temperature from multiple CMIP5 GCMs was bias-corrected against ERA5 reanalysis to produce extreme heat probability surfaces. Drought probability was computed from ISIMIP2b land surface model soil moisture and runoff outputs. Population exposure was calculated by intersecting event grids with GHS-POP R2023A gridded population using the ISIMIP Exposure Processing Pipeline.

resources.title: Annual Probability of Extreme Heat and Drought Events - Global Gridded Dataset
resources.description: Zip archive containing GeoTIFF files with annual probability of occurrence for drought and heatwave events at 0.5° resolution. Files are organized by event type (drought-occurrence-expected/heatwave-occurrence-expected), climate model (gfdl-esm2m, hadgem2-es, ipsl-cm5a-lr, miroc5), hydrological model (clm45, h08, jules-w1, lpjml, matsiro, mpi-hm, orchidee, pcr-globwb, watergap2 for drought; climate model direct output for heatwave), emission scenario (historical, rcp26, rcp60), and time period (2020, 2030, 2050, 2080). Each GeoTIFF contains gridded probability values and expected population exposure. File naming convention: {event-type}_{gcm}_{impact-model}_{scenario}_{period}.tif

events.description: Annual probability of drought occurrence for historical scenario across 4 time periods (2020, 2030, 2050, 2080). Includes 4 GCMs (GFDL-ESM2M, HadGEM2-ES, IPSL-CM5A-LR, MIROC5) combined with 9 hydrological models (CLM4.5, H08, JULES-W1, LPJmL, MATSIRO, MPI-HM, ORCHIDEE, PCR-GLOBWB, WaterGAP2), totaling 144 model-scenario combinations at 0.5° resolution.

Annual probability of drought occurrence for RCP2.6 scenario across 4 time periods (2020, 2030, 2050, 2080). Includes 4 GCMs (GFDL-ESM2M, HadGEM2-ES, IPSL-CM5A-LR, MIROC5) combined with 8 hydrological models (CLM4.5, H08, JULES-W1, LPJmL, MATSIRO, MPI-HM, ORCHIDEE, PCR-GLOBWB), totaling 128 model-scenario combinations at 0.5° resolution.

Annual probability of drought occurrence for RCP6.0 scenario across 4 time periods (2020, 2030, 2050, 2080). Includes 4 GCMs (GFDL-ESM2M, HadGEM2-ES, IPSL-CM5A-LR, MIROC5) combined with 8 hydrological models (CLM4.5, H08, JULES-W1, LPJmL, MATSIRO, MPI-HM, ORCHIDEE, PCR-GLOBWB), totaling 128 model-scenario combinations at 0.5° resolution.
